committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects medical professionals, students, training institutions, nursing workforce centers, and underserved pediatric populations.
dimensions.evidence: support recruiting, training, and retaining individuals to work or teach in the health professions

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts authorized funding amounts and refines service obligations and grant requirements for healthcare education programs.
dimensions.evidence: half of the required service hours per contract year must be providing direct clinical care

dimensions.assessment: Alters authorization funding levels across multiple sections, such as setting specific amounts like $48,245,000 for section 753(d) and $10,000,000 for section 775.
dimensions.evidence: $48,245,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple sections of Title VII of the Public Health Service Act regarding health professions and training programs.
dimensions.evidence: Title VII of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 292 et seq.) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Extends program authorizations through fiscal year 2031.
dimensions.evidence: reauthorizes through FY2031 and revises a range of programs

missing_information: Actual appropriations enacted, as the bill alters authorizations of appropriations rather than direct spending.
importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes and revises Title VII health workforce programs through FY2031, modifying funding levels and expanding eligibility requirements for pediatric and nursing workforce grants.
